اختتمتن (form VIII)
# اِخْتَتَمْتُنَّ (iḵtatamtunna) /ix.ta.tam.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
# اُخْتُتِمْتُنَّ (uḵtutimtunna) /ux.tu.tim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَتَمَ (iḵtatama)
